_comment: Windows 10 end-of-support and ESU dates. Kept out of code because Microsoft has changed them several times. Overridden by %ProgramData%\PCDoctor\config\os-support.json when present (the update check writes it). Every ESU row is marked verify until checked against Microsoft's lifecycle page.

esu.note: Originally announced end date. Some 2026 coverage reports an extension; check Microsoft's page.
Reported by Help Net Security, June 2026. Not confirmed from a Microsoft primary source.
Paid commercial program, up to three years.
